differences.title: 1. DEPLOYMENT
differences.leftDesc: Runs as a standalone server, accessible by multiple clients over a network.
differences.rightDesc: Library linked directly into the application, no separate server process.

differences.title: 2. SCALABILITY
differences.leftDesc: Designed for concurrent connections and large datasets, scales well with hardware.
differences.rightDesc: Best for single-user or low-concurrency scenarios, not designed for high traffic.

differences.title: 3. CONCURRENCY
differences.leftDesc: Handles multiple simultaneous read/write operations efficiently with MVCC.
differences.rightDesc: Relies on file locking; write operations can block other operations.

differences.title: 4. FEATURES
differences.leftDesc: Supports complex SQL, JSONB, full-text search, advanced indexing, extensions.
differences.rightDesc: Provides essential SQL features, suitable for simpler data management needs.

differences.title: 5. ADMINISTRATION
differences.leftDesc: Needs setup, configuration, and ongoing maintenance by a database administrator.
differences.rightDesc: No server setup or administration required; database is just a file.

differences.title: 6. USE CASES
differences.leftDesc: Ideal for complex applications, analytics, and large-scale systems.
differences.rightDesc: Perfect for local storage, mobile apps, IoT devices, and simple sites.

differences.title: 7. DATA INTEGRITY
differences.leftDesc: ACID compliant with robust transaction management and referential integrity.
differences.rightDesc: ACID compliant, but concurrency limits can impact write integrity.
